verdict.rationale: Idempotency keys are a fair question for a payments API like Flutterwave. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions idempotency keys, safe retries, or protection against duplicate charges. The pack covers only general API, SDK and product-feature descriptions, so this applicable capability has no support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can safely retry any API request using idempotency keys so network failures never create duplicate charges
